title: Prepare signed FACe supplier SOAP v1 requests for the test environment
notes: The public production and test WSDLs publish different operation namespaces and SOAPAction URLs. Use the selected binding in both places before signing.
done_when: Generate a locally verifiable test request with the namespace and action declared by the official test WSDL, while maintaining production as the default.
result: Prepare signed FACe supplier SOAP v1 requests for the test environment
evidence: The official sandbox WSDL and local request use the same namespace and SOAPAction. pnpm exec vitest run src/face src/cli/commands/facePreparar.test.ts passed all 28 tests, including independent xmlsec1 checks of both bindings and rejection of modified SOAP bodies.
